'''July 2001 Ottawa tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Ottawa, Ontario on 8 July 2001. [[Martin Leblanc]] won it. It is known from Thomas Dowling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2599">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-08-ottawa-canada-8-7-01d2599/ ottawa-canada-8-7-01], DeckTech (Thomas "COTEB" Dowling, 8 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-08-ottawa-canada-8-7-01d2599/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Ottawa, Ontario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Martin Leblanc]]
